name: freshgate-monorepo
description: FreshGate: Bifrost Gateway Plugin & Freshness Verification Engine

scripts.setup: pnpm -C engine install && pnpm -C dashboard install && pnpm -C demo install
scripts.check: pnpm -C engine check && pnpm -C engine test
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules engine/node_modules dashboard/node_modules demo/node_modules engine/dist dashboard/.next data
